rule: MR β>0 → 需抑制靶点；MR β<0 → 需激活靶点；相反即 Mismatch
note: SEVERE 仅在 Grade A 证据下抛出；Grade B 降为 WARN，避免弱 MR 一票否决全部分析
discussion_snippet: Directional consistency check. For 1 target(s), genetic evidence indicated that increased expression was protective, whereas the compound–target network predicted inhibition: IL6（MR β=0.42, p=1e-06）. Such target–intervention mismatch argues against a causal reading of these nodes and they were therefore downgraded to hypothesis-generating only.
